pages.title: Glitch
pages.note: The number takes a short hit of colour separation, sliced into bands, then settles. Three stacked copies and a clipped keyframe, no canvas.

source.name: glitch-404.tsx
source.note: the page itself. copy it into components/404lab.

pages.title: Mosaic
pages.desc: The scene arrives in twelve tiles
pages.note: Twelve tiles of one photograph reassemble from their own centre. Hover to take the picture apart and put it back in a different order.

source.name: mosaic-404.tsx
source.note: the page itself. copy it into components/404lab.

pages.title: Odometer
pages.desc: Three reels spin to a stop
pages.note: Mechanical reels overshoot their target and settle into 404. The middle reel always arrives last, which is the only joke in the mechanism.

source.name: odometer-404.tsx
source.note: the page itself. copy it into components/404lab.

pages.title: Spotlight
pages.desc: Only the cursor lights the page
pages.note: The scene sits in the dark. A soft mask follows the pointer and brings back the part of the page you are looking at.

source.name: spotlight-404.tsx
source.note: the page itself. copy it into components/404lab.

pages.title: Shatter
pages.note: The scene is cut on a nine-piece lattice. On hover the pieces spring apart, carrying the numerals with them, and fall back into place.

source.name: shatter-404.tsx
source.note: the page itself. copy it into components/404lab.

pages.title: Ticker
pages.note: A split-flap board shuffles random characters before it settles on the number. The rows underneath are honest about the destination.

source.name: ticker-404.tsx
source.note: the page itself. copy it into components/404lab.

pages.title: Gravity
pages.note: Each digit drops on its own spring and lands with a small rotation. The ground takes the weight, so the offset is not perfectly even.

source.name: gravity-404.tsx
source.note: the page itself. copy it into components/404lab.

pages.title: Holo
pages.desc: A transmission that will not lock
pages.note: Scanlines, a rolling refresh bar and a colour split that keeps slipping. The signal has been coming from nowhere for a long time.

source.name: holo-404.tsx
source.note: the page itself. copy it into components/404lab.

pages.title: Stroke
pages.note: The numerals are drawn by a single stroke and then filled in behind the line. It is dash offset all the way down, no font trick.

source.name: stroke-404.tsx
source.note: the page itself. copy it into components/404lab.

pages.title: Magnet
pages.note: Each digit has its own pull, so the number leans unevenly toward the pointer. Let go and the springs put it back.

source.name: magnet-404.tsx
source.note: the page itself. copy it into components/404lab.

pages.title: Fog
pages.note: Three layers of mist drift across a scene that is already half erased. Hover and the number sinks a little further into it.

source.name: fog-404.tsx
source.note: the page itself. copy it into components/404lab.

pages.title: Terminal
pages.desc: The shell gives up on you
pages.note: A shell that types its own failure, once when it comes into view and again when you ask it to.

source.name: terminal-404.tsx
source.note: the page itself. copy it into components/404lab.

pages.title: Domino
pages.note: Nine slabs stand in a row. The thin ones fall first and the three numerals follow, then the whole line stands back up on its own.

pages.title: Constellation
pages.note: 404 drawn as a constellation: edges first, then the stars arrive. Hover and the survey is charted again from the beginning.

pages.title: Stack
pages.note: Five copies of the number recede into depth on a shared perspective. Hover and the corridor collapses into one clean mark.

pages.title: Drag
pages.note: The number is an object you can pull off its origin. It stretches away under your hand and the spring walks it back when you let go.

source.name: drag-404.tsx

pages.title: Tilt
pages.desc: A small stage with three depths
pages.note: The card is built from three planes: scene, route line and number. The pointer tilts the whole thing and the light moves with it.

pages.title: Defocus
pages.desc: A lens that will not resolve
pages.note: Fourteen slices of the same numeral, offset like a lens with the wrong diopter. Hover and the slices line up long enough to read.

source.name: defocus-404.tsx
source.note: the page itself. copy it into components/404lab.

pages.title: Door
pages.note: A door in the middle of the page, with the number printed across it. It opens onto nothing, which is the correct answer.

pages.title: Viewfinder
pages.note: A camera hunting for a subject that is not there. Hover and it focuses on the number anyway, then flags the frame as empty.

pages.title: Sweep
pages.desc: An outline fills from the left
pages.note: An outline of the number fills behind a moving hairline. It only ever fills on the way in, so the page is briefly complete.

source.name: sweep-404.tsx
source.note: the page itself. copy it into components/404lab.

pages.title: Rubber
pages.note: Press and pull the number out of proportion. The spring puts it back harder than you took it, which is the whole interaction.

source.name: rubber-404.tsx
source.note: the page itself. copy it into components/404lab.

pages.title: Orbit
pages.note: The zero becomes a planet with one moon on a slow orbit. Under reduced motion the moon holds still and the page still reads.

pages.title: Morse
pages.note: A single lamp blinks 404 in Morse. The digits only arrive after the signal has finished, which takes longer than you expect.

pages.title: Trail

pages.title: Tear
